events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Antonio Gates caught a 14-yard scoring pass from Philip Rivers on the game's opening drive to snap a streak of six straight quarters without a touchdown, and the San Diego Chargers went on to a 31-13 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers force 4 turnovers, ease past Chiefs

headlines.description: Peyton Manning overcame a pair of interceptions by throwing three touchdown passes Sunday, rallying Denver to a 31-23 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning rallies Broncos, now 8-0 vs. Bengals

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Tom Crabtree had a 72-yard touchdown that was Green Bay's longest of the season, and the Green Bay Packers got a 31-17 victory Sunday against the Arizona Cardinals, who lost their fifth straight.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cobb snags 2 of Rodgers' 4 TDs as Pack cruise

headlines.description: Brian Urlacher became the latest Chicago defender to return an interception for a touchdown and Jay Cutler threw three TD passes to Brandon Marshall as the Bears routed the Tennessee Titans 51-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Urlacher pick-six caps dominant day by Bears D

headlines.description: Andrew Luck broke the NFL's single-game rookie record by throwing for 433 yards in leading Indianapolis past Miami 23-20 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts' Luck sets mark, wins duel with Tannehill

headlines.description: Cam Newton completed 13-of-23 passes for 201 yards with a touchdown and ran eight times for 37 yards and a score as the Carolina Panthers snapped a five-game losing streak Sunday with a 21-13 win over the Washington Redskins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers end 5-game skid, stick it to Redskins

headlines.description: Mikel Leshoure ran for three touchdowns, Calvin Johnson got involved early and the Detroit Lions turned in their most complete victory of the season, 31-14 over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leshoure's three scores help Lions rout Jags

headlines.description: Matt Schaub threw two touchdown passes, Arian Foster ran for 111 yards against Buffalo's NFL-worst rushing defense and the Houston Texans beat former top pick Mario Williams and the Bills 21-9 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schaub, Foster lift Texans past Williams' Bills

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Rookie Doug Martin rushed for a franchise-record 251 yards and four touchdowns, as the Tampa Bay Buccaneers held on to beat the Oakland Raiders 42-32 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Martin races to 251 yards, 4 TDs as Bucs win

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch ran for 124 yards and a touchdown, rookie QB Russell Wilson threw three first-half touchdowns, and the Seattle Seahawks overcame 182 yards rushing by Adrian Peterson in a 30-20 win over the Minnesota Vikings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson guides Seahawks by Peterson, Vikings

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New York Giants

headlines.description: Isaac Redman ran for 147 yards and the winning touchdown with 4:02 remaining Sunday as the Pittsburgh Steelers rallied past the New York Giants, 24-20.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redman's late TD pushes Steelers past Giants

headlines.description: The Falcons beat the Cowboys 19-13 on Sunday night to extend their run as the NFL's only unbeaten team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Turner carries unbeaten Falcons by Cowboys

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw two touchdown passes, extending his NFL record streak to 51 games, and Patrick Robinson returned an interception 99 yards for a score to lead the New Orleans Saints to a much-needed win, 28-13 over the reeling Philadelphia Eagles.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robinson's 99-yard pick-6 lifts Saints by Eagles
